financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 10,250,000 shares with accompanying common warrants at $0.98; proceeds to the company before expenses (expected close 2025-03-25; closing not confirmed in the excerpts)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Offering is expected to close on March 25, 2025.

The Series A-1 Warrants and Series A-2 Warrants became exercisable commencing June 9, 2023, and are exercisable for three years at an exercise price of $130.00 per share
